description: Unit test class for the GenericRowKeyboard component in the AnySoftKeyboard project, testing popup behavior for symbols and mode change keys under different conditions.

classes.name: GenericRowKeyboardTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying popup behavior in GenericRowKeyboard.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test environment, including context, default add-on, and row extension.

methods.name: testHasPopupForSymbolsWhenFromAlphabetKeyboard
methods.description: Verifies that the symbol key shows a popup when the keyboard is in alphabet mode.

methods.name: testHasPopupForChangeModeWhenFromAlphabetKeyboard
methods.description: Verifies that the mode change key shows a popup when the keyboard is in alphabet mode.

methods.name: testDoesNotHavePopupSymbolsWhenFromNonAlphabetKeyboard
methods.description: Ensures that the symbol key does not show a popup when the keyboard is not in alphabet mode.

methods.name: testDoesNotHavePopupSymbolsWhenNoSymbolsKeyboard
methods.description: Checks that no symbol popup appears when the keyboard lacks symbols.

methods.name: testDoesNotHavePopupSymbolsWhenNoSymbolsKeyboardInNonAlphabet
methods.description: Checks that no symbol popup appears in non-alphabet mode when symbols are absent.
